Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

breakdown.label: · Transfer / Back from Hostie — Hostie xfer 50.9% of AI

notes: Sankey + Bounce count UNIQUE calls in business hours only (TalkDesk In Business Hours? = TRUE).

To hit 75% human-answered: need 285 more human answers → ~3.67 extra agents at this week’s 77.63/agent pace (8 agents today).

Back from Hostie outcomes (342 unique): human 59.9% · still If-No-Answer 14.9% · abandoned after Back 25.1% · empty 0%.
Abandoned unique calls: 262 (21.7% of unique BH inbound) — these never reached a human.
Target 75% human-answered = 290 of 386 unique calls (business hours).
Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 150 (38.9%) → need 140 more human answers.
This week 7 unique named agents answered (~21.43 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~13.53 agents total (≈ +6.53 vs today’s 7).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

notes: Sankey + Bounce count UNIQUE calls in business hours only (TalkDesk In Business Hours? = TRUE).

Back from Hostie outcomes (291 unique): human 63.6% · still If-No-Answer 15.5% · abandoned after Back 21% · empty 0%.
Abandoned unique calls: 225 (20.7% of unique BH inbound) — these never reached a human.
Target 75% human-answered = 374 of 498 unique calls (business hours).
Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 275 (55.2%) → need 99 more human answers.
This week 8 unique named agents answered (~34.38 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~10.88 agents total (≈ +2.88 vs today’s 8).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

breakdown.label: · Transfer / Back from Hostie — Hostie xfer 22.6% of AI

notes: Sankey + Bounce count UNIQUE calls in business hours only (TalkDesk In Business Hours? = TRUE).
Same Customer Phone Number + ≤90s between end→next start = one session; outcome = LAST leg.
All inbound → MAIN line | Abandoned; MAIN → HUMAN (main) | AI / If-No-Answer; Abandoned splits by hangup (IVR / waiting / disconnected).
This view: 512 unique calls from 789 TalkDesk legs (business hours).
Bounce until human: avg 1.61 failed leg(s) before pickup (MAIN If-No-Answer + Back If-No-Answer count; human last leg does not), avg 144s first→human (median 1 / 88s) · 109 unique calls.
To hit 75% human-answered: need 138 more human answers → ~4.49 extra agents at this week’s 30.75/agent pace (8 agents today).
AI only count = sessions ending on MAIN If-No-Answer; Hostie transfer share stays in bounce / notes, not on node labels.
Back from Hostie outcomes (128 unique): human 68.8% · still If-No-Answer 18% · abandoned after Back 13.3% · empty 0%.
Abandoned unique calls: 120 (23.4% of unique BH inbound) — these never reached a human.
Target 75% human-answered = 816 of 1,088 unique calls (business hours).
Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 577 (53%) → need 239 more human answers.
This week 8 unique named agents answered (~72.13 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~11.31 agents total (≈ +3.31 vs today’s 8).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

breakdown.label: · Transfer / Back from Hostie — Hostie xfer 87.6% of AI

notes: Sankey + Bounce count UNIQUE calls in business hours only (TalkDesk In Business Hours? = TRUE).
Same Customer Phone Number + ≤90s between end→next start = one session; outcome = LAST leg.
All inbound → MAIN line | Abandoned; MAIN → HUMAN (main) | AI / If-No-Answer; Abandoned splits by hangup (IVR / waiting / disconnected).
This view: 1,124 unique calls from 1,659 TalkDesk legs (business hours).
Bounce until human: avg 1.3 failed leg(s) before pickup (MAIN If-No-Answer + Back If-No-Answer count; human last leg does not), avg 121s first→human (median 1 / 98s) · 234 unique calls.
To hit 75% human-answered: need 234 more human answers → ~4.23 extra agents at this week’s 55.36/agent pace (11 agents today).
AI only count = sessions ending on MAIN If-No-Answer; Hostie transfer share stays in bounce / notes, not on node labels.
Back from Hostie outcomes (292 unique): human 65.1% · still If-No-Answer 12.3% · abandoned after Back 22.6% · empty 0%.
Abandoned unique calls: 252 (22.4% of unique BH inbound) — these never reached a human.
Target 75% human-answered = 467 of 622 unique calls (business hours).
Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 329 (52.9%) → need 138 more human answers.
This week 11 unique named agents answered (~29.91 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~15.61 agents total (≈ +4.61 vs today’s 11).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

notes: Sankey + Bounce count UNIQUE calls in business hours only (TalkDesk In Business Hours? = TRUE).

Abandoned unique calls: 273 (22.5% of unique BH inbound) — these never reached a human.
Target 75% human-answered = 193 of 257 unique calls (business hours).
Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 102 (39.7%) → need 91 more human answers.
This week 7 unique named agents answered (~14.57 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~13.25 agents total (≈ +6.25 vs today’s 7).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 683 (53.7%) → need 271 more human answers.
This week 8 unique named agents answered (~85.38 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~11.17 agents total (≈ +3.17 vs today’s 8).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
definitions.source: Unique sessions − HUMAN TOUCHED

breakdown.label: · Transfer / Back from Hostie — Hostie xfer 75.9% of AI

notes: Sankey + Bounce count UNIQUE calls in business hours only (TalkDesk In Business Hours? = TRUE).
Same Customer Phone Number + ≤90s between end→next start = one session; outcome = LAST leg.
All inbound → MAIN line | Abandoned; MAIN → HUMAN (main) | AI / If-No-Answer; Abandoned splits by hangup (IVR / waiting / disconnected).
This view: 1,221 unique calls from 2,107 TalkDesk legs (business hours).
Bounce until human: avg 1.16 failed leg(s) before pickup (MAIN If-No-Answer + Back If-No-Answer count; human last leg does not), avg 70s first→human (median 1 / 52s) · 563 unique calls.
To hit 75% human-answered: need 353 more human answers → ~6.9 extra agents at this week’s 51.18/agent pace (11 agents today).
AI only count = sessions ending on MAIN If-No-Answer; Hostie transfer share stays in bounce / notes, not on node labels.
Back from Hostie outcomes (691 unique): human 81.5% · still If-No-Answer 0% · abandoned after Back 18.5% · empty 0%.
Abandoned unique calls: 157 (12.9% of unique BH inbound) — these never reached a human.
Target 75% human-answered = 203 of 270 unique calls (business hours).
Current HUMAN TOUCHED = 91 (33.7%) → need 112 more human answers.
This week 9 unique named agents answered (~10.11 unique human-answered calls per agent).
At current productivity → ~20.08 agents total (≈ +11.08 vs today’s 9).
Assumption: each extra agent answers the same # of unique human calls as this week’s average. Does not model AHT, occupancy, or schedule fit.

Same Customer Phone Number with ≤1 min 30 sec between one leg’s end and the next leg’s start = one call. Outcome uses the LAST leg (did they reach a human at the end?).
includes: Customer Phone Number clusters with gap ≤ 1 min 30 sec
MAIN line (incl. AI / Back from Hostie) · Abandoned
excludes: Outside business hours (In Business Hours? = FALSE)
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · In Business Hours? = TRUE · unique sessions by Customer Phone + 90s gap · VIP/Membership excluded

definitions.title: MAIN line
definitions.definition: Inbound on the restaurant main TalkDesk path (includes sessions that later transfer via Back from Hostie). Splits into HUMAN (main), AI / If-No-Answer, or empty agent.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Phone Display Name

definitions.title: Abandoned
definitions.definition: Unique session whose LAST leg is abandoned — never connected. Split by Hangup reason: Left in IVR, Left waiting, Disconnected (and other).
includes: Call Type = abandoned on last leg
excludes: Any last leg that reached an Agent Name
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Call Type + Hangup on last leg

definitions.title: Left in IVR
definitions.definition: Abandoned hang-up while still in the IVR (Hangup = ivr).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Disconnected
definitions.definition: Abandoned with Hangup = disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Left waiting
definitions.definition: Abandoned while waiting in queue (Hangup = waiting).
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: Abandoned other
definitions.definition: Abandoned with a Hangup value other than ivr / waiting / disconnected.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Hangup

definitions.title: HUMAN (main)
definitions.definition: Named human answered on the MAIN inbound last leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
includes: Agent Name set and not If-No-Answer
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on MAIN inbound

definitions.title: AI / If-No-Answer
definitions.definition: MAIN path with If-No-Answer Agent — Hostie/AI. Splits into Back-from-Hostie transfer outcomes vs AI only.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name = If-No-Answer Agent

definitions.title: Empty agent
definitions.definition: MAIN last leg with blank Agent Name → HUMAN did not.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name

definitions.title: AI only (no transfer)
definitions.definition: If-No-Answer with no Back-from-Hostie CC last leg. Handled by Hostie/AI without returning to CC. % of AI = Hostie phoneCalls − transferred.
definitions.source: TalkDesk If-No-Answer last leg; Hostie % from phoneCalls − transferred

definitions.title: HUMAN (transfer)
definitions.definition: Named human answered the Back-from-Hostie leg. Counts toward HUMAN TOUCHED.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: No pickup (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie still If-No-Answer — transferred but no human pickup.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · If-No-Answer on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: Empty (transfer)
definitions.definition: Back-from-Hostie with blank Agent Name.
definitions.source: TalkDesk CSV · blank Agent Name on Back from Hostie

definitions.title: HUMAN TOUCHED
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg reached a named human (main or Back-from-Hostie). Redials inside a 90-second session count once — only the final leg decides.
includes: Last leg = named agent on MAIN
Last leg = named agent on Back-from-Hostie
definitions.source: TalkDesk · last leg of unique session

definitions.title: HUMAN did not
definitions.definition: Unique call whose LAST leg never reached a named human: abandoned (by hangup reason), AI only, no-pickup transfer, or empty agent.
includes: No pickup on transfer last leg
